summary: Diff adds an Edit Profile dialog and wires an Edit Profile entry point into the SiteHeader account dropdown for authenticated users. It appears to reuse existing profile query/mutation hooks, with no backend changes shown. Some acceptance criteria are not clearly met based on the diff, and there are unrelated URL parameter utility changes.

missing_requirements.requirement: When a user is signed in, there is a visible entry point labeled "Edit Profile" available from the main UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The header only renders the account dropdown (which contains the Edit Profile entry point) when `isAuthenticated && userProfile` is truthy. If a user is authenticated but `userProfile` is not yet loaded/available, there may be no visible "Edit Profile" entry point.

missing_requirements.requirement: After saving, any UI that depends on the caller profile reflects the updated name without requiring a full page reload.
missing_requirements.reason: The dialog calls `useSaveCallerUserProfile().mutate(...)` and closes on success, but the diff does not show any explicit React Query cache update/invalidation or refetch to ensure `useGetCallerUserProfile()` consumers (e.g., SiteHeader display name) update immediately.

hallucinated_features.description: Expanded URL parameter utilities including sessionStorage persistence and hash query parsing/cleanup helpers.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest is focused on adding profile editing UI using existing profile APIs; changes to URL param/session storage utilities are not requested by REQ-1/REQ-2.
